entities.name: Alexandrite
entities.description: Daughter of the Kjeldoran king Darien the Great, who co-founded New Argive with Lothar.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Wizard who fell sick with plague.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Owner of old materials shown to Jodah and Jaya.

entities.name: Blue Storm clan
entities.description: Clan from whom aid was sought.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Nation founded by Alexandrite and Lothar.

entities.name: Kjeld
entities.description: Kjeldoran capital visited by Jodah and Jaya.

events.summary: Alexandrite's mother dies when she is five; Darien's second wife dies of one of Krov's plagues.
events.quote: Alexandrite's mother, King Darien 's first wife, died when Alexandrite was five years old.

events.summary: Alexandrite receives Jodah and Jaya Ballard at Kjeld.
events.quote: Alexandrite received Jodah and Jaya Ballard from her throne

events.summary: Alexandrite flies the sick Jaya and Jodah to Lovisa's camp and meets Lothar.
events.quote: This is where she met Lovisa's son Lothar Lovisason .

events.summary: Alexandrite and Lothar fly north to get aid from the Blue Storm clan.
events.quote: the two of them together went on a flight north to get aid from the Blue Storm clan

events.summary: Alexandrite and Lothar fall in love and found New Argive.
events.quote: they stood as the founders of the fledgling nation of New Argive

relations.quote: Alexandrite was the daughter of the Kjeldoran king Darien the Great.
Alexandrite and Lothar later fell in love
